rv.q: Let’s acknowledge it as a slick, inventive, hilarious production which is the funniest thing I’ve seen for many years.
Revival of hit Hitchcockian parody swaps suspense for uneven farce
Derby Theatre and Hull Truck Theatre have created something exceptional here.
It’s daft, dazzling and quite possibly the funniest thing I’ve seen all year.
Chaotic, inventive, warm and completely ridiculous, The 39 Steps is theatrical silliness executed with serious skill.
Hull Truck Theatre has once again delivered an excellent production: refreshingly different, brilliantly performed and so funny it will leave your face aching from laughter.
If you want a good laugh, I'd highly recommend it.

cn.t: Critics hail this production as gloriously hilarious theatrical lunacy, with Cal McCrystal's direction transforming Hitchcock's thriller into brilliantly ridiculous comedy through inventive staging and physical humor that leaves audiences crying with laughter.
